purpose: Define the ordered four-slot emoji syntax surrounding a Caeluviim protocol lexeme and distinguish each slot by grammatical function, semantic scope, and provenance.

ebnf: surface-expression = [leading-rider, space], protocol-lexeme, [space, trailing-rider], space, host-gloss ;
surface_grammar.spacing_rule: Occupied glyphs inside a rider cluster are adjacent. A single space separates an occupied leading cluster from the lexeme, an occupied trailing cluster from the lexeme, and the completed rider expression from the bracketed host-language gloss.
surface_grammar.empty_slot_rule: Empty slots emit no placeholder. A glyph retains its declared slot identity; an occupied L2 does not become L1 merely because L1 is empty, and the same rule applies to T2 when T1 is empty.

L1.name: ontological-class slot
L1.function: States the broad ontological sort or primary class of the lexeme: what kind of entity, event, relation, claim, or process it is.
L1.scope: Outer leading scope. L1 classifies the L2-plus-lexeme core when L2 is occupied; otherwise it classifies the lexeme directly.

L2.name: subtype-role-operator slot
L2.function: States the narrower subtype, role, modality, domain operator, or active semantic transformation through which the lexeme is instantiated.
L2.scope: Inner leading scope. L2 binds most closely to the protocol lexeme before L1 is applied.

T1.name: relation-state-inflection slot
T1.function: States the current relational configuration, grammatical inflection, number, temporal state, affective state, or operational condition of the typed lexeme.
T1.scope: Inner trailing scope. T1 qualifies the typed lexeme expression before T2 applies.

T2.name: governance-provenance-validation slot
T2.function: States the authority, provenance, evidentiary, verification, consent, governance, or ratification status under which the complete expression is being used.
T2.scope: Outermost scope. T2 qualifies the complete L1-L2-lexeme-T1 expression rather than merely modifying the lexical head.

parse_order: Bind L2 to the protocol lexeme when L2 is occupied.
Apply L1 to the resulting core when L1 is occupied.
Apply T1 as the current relation, state, or inflection when T1 is occupied.
Apply T2 to the complete expression as governance, provenance, or validation scope when T2 is occupied.
Render the current host-language access term in square brackets after the completed rider expression.
composition.multi_relation_rule: The emoji layer is not a one-to-one word-to-glyph assignment system. Each occupied slot records a typed relation between a glyph and the lexeme expression.
composition.same_glyph_rule: The same glyph may occur in different slots or lexical entries only when each occurrence has separately recorded meaning, scope, source, and governance status.
composition.noncollapse_rule: A glyph's visual similarity or reuse must not collapse the distinct syntactic functions of L1, L2, T1, and T2.

person_application.reading: Anishinaabe is typed in the Person ontological class; no narrower operator, current state, or governance-status glyph is asserted by this minimal rendering.

relation_to_identity_rider: This protocol-lexeme grammar is distinct from the exact adjacency and rendering rules of identities/superposed-identity.emoji-rider.json. Shared glyphs may participate in both systems only with separately typed roles.
initiating_authority: User instruction on 2026-08-06 that protocol words may use up to four emoji, with two leading and two trailing.
User instruction on 2026-08-06 to impose syntax rules defining what each position does.
User approval of 👤 as a neutral Person glyph.
